info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Collateral Details API
info.description: This API allows for the modification of collateral details associated with specific loan applications. It supports updating necessary attributes that may affect the valuation or status of the collateral. Typical consumers include lenders and loan processing platforms that require up-to-date information on collateral for assessing loan applications. Using this API, businesses can ensure accurate and timely updates to their collateral information as loan scenarios evolve.

patch.summary: Update collateral for a loan application.
patch.description: This operation allows you to modify the collateral associated with a specific loan application identified by RES-100045. You can update details such as collateral type, value, and related information to ensure the loan application reflects the current collateral status.

requestBody.description: This request body allows the modification of collateral information for a specific loan application identified by RES-100045. It should contain the necessary attributes to update the current collateral details.
